info.name: URL Shortener
info.description: End-to-end checks for the URL Shortener API (docs/openapi.yaml). Run the whole collection in order (Runner, or `newman run`): it issues its own API keys, exercises every endpoint and error case, and cleans up. Needs the app running in the `local` profile (`./run-local.sh` or `run-local.bat`). Change the `baseUrl` collection variable if the app is not on http://localhost:8080.
